scope: Production wrapper revalidation of private C5 runtime source; original factory cold setup only, no C5 guest instructions or public enablement.

checks.limits: C5 cases are cold/protocol contracts with unchanged external inputs. The existing runtime suite also runs its established S3/StopWatch fixtures through the new production WASM; no original C5 guest execution is implied.

checks.result: Unchanged ROM/factory load; corrupt ROM and merged image rejection before mutation; bounded raw restore; ROM/SRAM profile recheck. No original bootloader/app/SD/LCD execution.
Worker C5 ROM/SRAM mode, restricted capabilities and32MiB Flash page protocol, plus existing channel/snapshot cases pass.

retainedHistoricalArtifact.role: Earlier raw Cargo-release ABI artifact, debug1 and DWARF present; its failed production-section qualification is retained in checks.json. It is not the artifact tested here.
